name: Lazuli
summary: Lazuli is crafted for both beauty and function. A ceramic top rests above a body wrapped in dark grey elm veneer, its interior lined with refined smoky tones. A mirrored backboard adds depth and light, while the hardwood wine shelf offers a touch of tradition. Brass-toned legs complete the piece with a subtle, modern glow. 110x42x135
